question: Should the experimental core Claws contract accept `CLAW.md` as a supported human-authored manifest and make it the canonical export format once the preceding lifecycle stack is ready?
rationale: This selects a durable user-facing package format and documentation contract; code review alone cannot decide whether that capability belongs in the experimental core surface.

options.title: Sponsor the canonical format
options.body: Keep `CLAW.md` in the experimental Claws stack, require current-head lifecycle proof and JSON round-trip coverage, then land in stack order.

options.title: Keep JSON-only for now
options.body: Defer the format adapter until the Claws lifecycle is established and preserve the existing JSON-only export contract.

options.title: Move format design to RFC follow-up
options.body: Pause this slice pending a narrower maintainer-approved manifest-format decision in the Claws RFC process.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the canonical format
recommendation.body: Keep `CLAW.md` in the experimental Claws stack, require current-head lifecycle proof and JSON round-trip coverage, then land in stack order.
